name.ja: 30MS オプションハンドパーツ ［ホワイト/ブラック］

ja: 豊富な種類のハンドパーツと、可動の広がりを実現した新規の首パーツで、各キャラクターの仕草を表情豊かに表現！
■4種の表情手が白、黒の各色で付属。
■「左右の可動」「前後の可動」を実現する可動方向の異なる首パーツが2種付属。
■素体の表情パーツを取り付ける頭部パーツが2点付属。
en: With a wide variety of hand parts and a new neck part that offers greater range of movement, each character's gestures can be expressively expressed!
• 4 types of expression hands are included in each color, white and black.
• Two types of neck parts with different movable directions are included to achieve "left and right movement " and " front and back movement."
• Two head parts are included to attach the body's expression parts.

ja: 表情付きハンドパーツ(左右)「4種×2色(黒・白)」
可動方向の異なる首パーツ(カラーA)「2種×2点」
素体(カラーA)共通の頭部パーツ「2点」
en: Hand parts with expressions (left and right) "4 types x 2 colors (black and white)"
Neck parts with different movable directions (color A) "2 types x 2 pieces"
2 common head parts for body (color A)
